text: With only backup instruments, the crew works out the glide by hand. The backup instruments don't even show how fast they're sinking. In ten nautical miles, they lose five thousand feet. At that rate, Winnipeg is too far. They would hit the ground first. First officer Maurice Quintal remembers an old air force base where he once served. Gimli. What nobody in the cockpit knows is that part of the old base is now a racetrack. And today, there's a car race on it.
